comparison.objective: Tune and lock a robot-axis damper from observed stopping behavior, versus dispense exactly ten selected tablets into a held vial without moving extras or spilling.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate emphasizes hex-key alignment, retained fastener manipulation, fine collar rotation, counterholding, torque-limited locking, and repeated control actuation. PR-740 emphasizes bimanual tray/vial positioning and controlled granular pouring into a small opening.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe, repeatable physical carriage stops and a lock witness test. PR-740 requires all ten counted tablets in an elevated vial, all six others retained on the counting area, and no spill; violations latch zero.
comparison.reason: The shared bimanual coordination is generic. Fastener adjustment followed by dynamic-response validation is materially different from exact-count granular transfer. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift tolerances remain undeclared numerically, without affecting this distinction.
